definitions.explanation: Precious ornaments set with gems or jewels, or the craft of creating such ornaments.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{宝飾|ほうしょく}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This jewelry store has a hundred years of history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{王族|おうぞく}→王族：13587_ouzoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけていた{宝飾|ほうしょく}{品|ひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The museum displays jewelry that was worn by royalty.

notes:
Composed of {宝|ほう} (treasure, precious) + {飾|しょく} (decoration, ornament). Most commonly appears in the compound {宝飾|ほうしょく}{品|ひん} (jewelry items) or {宝飾|ほうしょく}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (jewelry store). The word carries a sense of luxury and high-end craftsmanship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宝飾|ほうしょく}{品|ひん} — jewelry, precious ornaments
- {宝飾|ほうしょく}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ — jewelry store
- {宝飾|ほうしょく}⟦デザイナー→デザイナー：05061_dezainaa⟧ — jewelry designer
- {宝飾|ほうしょく}⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧ — jewelry industry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧ — accessories; broader category including non-precious items like fashion jewelry
- ⟦{装飾|そうしょく}{品|ひん}→装飾品：15213_soushokuhin⟧ — decorative items; broader than {宝飾|ほうしょく}, which specifically involves precious materials
- ⟦{宝石|ほうせき}→宝石：03619_houseki⟧ — gemstone, jewel; refers to the stones themselves, not the finished ornaments
